title: feat: add brand and help links to the docs menu
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The docs drawer now shows the pollinations.ai logo beside “Docs” and adds links to the Enter dashboard, the Discord help channel, and GitHub issues. “Copy for LLMs” gets higher-contrast styling, a tooltip explaining what it copies, and a same-width “Copied” confirmation. CI and deployment change detection now track the horizontal brand lockup used by the docs.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art reading nook, Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; small in the scene and wearing tiny librarian glasses, she points to a retro docs menu with the pollinations.ai logo and little paths toward a dashboard, a help chat, and a bug notebook. A code-plant grows beside the screen against a prominent lime green (#ecf874) and soft pastel gradient background; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites and a gentle CRT glow.
